purpose: Review a finite Campaign120 catalog against all 145 frozen definitions and select at most one genuinely distinct fixed-support mechanism before reading any Campaign120 source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price or forward return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_direction_dictionary_phrase_count_238s
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.design: Convert each half-session's 119 exact close-direction changes to the ternary alphabet -1,0,+1, reset a deterministic incremental dictionary at the start of each half, parse the complete sequence into shortest unseen phrases with one explicit terminal-reused-suffix rule, and sum the two phrase counts.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A larger repertoire of incrementally novel direction phrases indicates that completed-session price discovery was not dominated by stale quotes, one repeated tick-bounce motif, or a mechanically recurring local path; broader sequence novelty may represent more resilient information absorption from the next open through the third close.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.prevalue_support_case: Every exact 240-close session yields two fixed 119-symbol sequences and a finite integer score; no positive-return, variance, event-count, active-volume, range or lookback threshold is required.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_range_boundary_state_transition_entropy
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign119 explicitly excluded transition and conditional entropy over its frozen nine boundary-direction states. Reopening that state alphabet with a new transition operator would be a terminal-family rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_direction_fourgram_coverage
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A selected word length and distinct-word count is a tunable truncated version of the chosen full incremental dictionary parser; admitting both would create an unbounded n-gram search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_wick_shape_state_entropy
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign048 froze and terminated the upper/lower wick family and rejected wick entropy, serial and subwindow variants before values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_direction_dictionary_phrase_count
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Substituting amount weak-order or top-decile event states would reopen Campaign117 or Campaign118 after both terminal results; it is not an independent source mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: full_numeric_library_new_model_or_pair_search_137f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Complete-library supervised fitting, consensus, lower-quartile and rank-improvement aggregators are terminal. A refreshed model or selective pair search after their results would be post-exposure model rescue rather than a new mechanism.
